notes.title: Restart Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug causing the player to fall through the level when restarting after a death
 Improved on Steam API communication

notes.title: Achievement Trigger Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that was preventing some achievements from firing

notes.notes:
Added steam achievements and triggers
